findings.claim: The regenerated Markdown still flattens the central multi-line diff into one prose line, erasing the line boundaries and making the space, minus, and plus prefixes look like shell syntax. Related semantic rows are still concatenated in ai-assistant-setup and foundations-course-check, and the ai-assistant-setup defect carries into its PDF. The fixed derivation therefore has not resolved the learner-facing technical ambiguity.

evidence.section: Generating patch text with -p: patch hunks are line-oriented, and combined diff documentation defines space, minus, and plus as per-line column indicators.

findings.recommendation: Correct the shared Markdown derivation so preformatted diff children and definition-list or grid rows retain explicit line or row boundaries; regenerate all affected Markdown and Reading PDFs, then inspect both Markdown and pdftotext output. Do not hand-edit generated companions.

items.note: Resolved on current bytes. Objective o1 and the teaching now explicitly name three inputs the learner controls, while the page acknowledges conversation history, system or organization instructions, memory, tool results, automatically selected context, and permitted workspace reads. The aligned GIFT item asks which learner-controlled input is missing rather than denying conversation history.
